summary: Focused re-test of the 2 CRITICAL frontend bugs from iteration_5 plus targeted regressions. Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_admin_kb_rbac.py re-run — 45/45 passing (no regression). GET /api/admin/users now returns role/company_id/blocked/wallet_balance for ALL users including legacy docs (test-user-shared-002 => role 'user', company_id null, blocked false), no Mongo _id leaked. Frontend: /admin (AdminPanel) now renders without white-screen/TypeError — admin-panel + admin-users-table with 4 rows, role badges USER/USER/USER/SUPER_ADMIN (default 'USER' for legacy doc), no CRA error overlay, zero console/page errors; topup dialog opens. /profile direct load now prefills profile-name-input ('Görkem Elligram') and profile-save-btn is enabled; renamed to TEST_Renamed Admin, PATCH /api/auth/me persisted across reload, then restored. Regressions verified: /admin/super users list + topup dialog + submit persisted (₺100,00 -> ₺107,00 after reload, then reverted), KB upload -> list -> delete flow works end-to-end. Both previously CRITICAL bugs are FIXED.

minor.issue: Still loads usage_events per user in a Python loop (N+1); use an aggregation $group. Performance only, not a functional failure.
